payload.title: Decide projection-to-main snapshot freshness
payload.body: The projection force-pushes TASKS.md to the tasksmd/generated-snapshot branch, so main lags the live log until a human opens and merges a PR from it (the step named 'Open/update the snapshot PR' opens no PR). Decide whether to auto-merge the snapshot PR, commit directly to main, or keep the manual gate, and document the chosen freshness contract in spec.md.
